channel.title: LedgerCaddy updates
channel.description: New versions of LedgerCaddy for Mac.

item.title: LedgerCaddy 1.0.0-rc.146
item.description: LedgerCaddy now updates itself: it checks once a day and installs new versions with one click. Also in this version: shorter licence keys, a Profit & Loss report, renameable tax names, and the LedgerCaddy mark as the app icon.
